desc: Built for hunters and precision shooters who demand performance without excess weight, the Fierce Carbon Rogue XP is the best-selling rifle in the Fierce lineup. Starting at 5.8 lbs, it pairs the proven Fierce Dual-Lug Stainless Steel Action with a C3 match grade carbon barrel and Rogue C3 Carbon Stock — delivering a genuinely lightweight precision rifle that doesn’t cut corners on accuracy. Every Carbon Rogue XP carries a .75 MOA accuracy guarantee.
